```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
require("knitr")
library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr)
library(stringr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE) 
```

In a first step, the results given by the Nextflow pipeline are loaded.

```{r load-R-data}
load("../results/fitness/result.Rdata")
load("../input/CRISPR_2022_dataSet_forShinyLib/CRISPRi_library_2022.Rdata")

annotation <- unique(CRISPRi_library_2022[,c(1,26:33)])
DESeq_result_table <- DESeq_result_table %>% left_join(annotation)
DESeq_result_table$FoldChange <- 2^DESeq_result_table$log2FoldChange
CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys <- DESeq_result_table
```

```{r fix-gene-names}
CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys[grepl("nc_", CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys$sgRNA),]$sgRNA_type <- "non-coding"
CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys[grepl("nc_", CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys$sgRNA),]$protein <- "non-coding RNA"
CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys[grepl("nc_", CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys$sgRNA),]$process <- "non-coding RNA"
CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys[grepl("nc_", CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys$sgRNA),]$pathway <- "unknown"

df_ncRNAs <- as.data.frame(str_split_fixed(CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys[grepl("nc_", CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys$sgRNA_target),]$sgRNA_target, "_", 2))
df_ncRNAs$sgRNA_target <- CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys[grepl("nc_", CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys$sgRNA),]$sgRNA_target
df_ncRNAs <- unique(df_ncRNAs[,c(2,3)])
names(df_ncRNAs) <- c("locus", "sgRNA_target")
CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys <- rows_patch(CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys, df_ncRNAs, by="sgRNA_target")
ncRNA_annotation <- read_tsv("../input/ncRNAs_CRISPRi.csv")
CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys <- rows_patch(CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys, ncRNA_annotation, by="locus", unmatched="ignore")
names(df_ncRNAs) <- c("gene_name", "sgRNA_target")
df_ncRNAs <- tibble(df_ncRNAs)
CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys <- rows_patch(CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys, df_ncRNAs, by="sgRNA_target")

CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys[is.na(CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys$gene_name_short),]$gene_name_short <- CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys[is.na(CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys$gene_name_short),]$gene_name

list_with_locus_tags <- (grepl("sll", CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys$gene_name) | grepl("slr", CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys$gene_name) | grepl("sml", CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys$gene_name) | grepl("smr", CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys$gene_name) | grepl("ssr", CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys$gene_name) | grepl("ssl", CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys$gene_name) | grepl("nc_", CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys$sgRNA_target))
CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys[!list_with_locus_tags, ]$gene_name <- paste(CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys[!list_with_locus_tags, ]$gene_name_short, CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys[!list_with_locus_tags, ]$locus, sep=" ")
ncRNAs <- subset(CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys, CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys$sgRNA_type=="non-coding")
```

```{r save}
save(CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys, file = "../R_results/CRISPRi_library_2025_Lys.Rdata")
```
